negative.prompt: What STT is charged when I sell a Nifty option?

evals.prompt: For an NSE delivery trade, is GST 18% of the total of all charges, including STT and stamp duty?
expectations: Says GST is 18% of brokerage + SEBI fee + exchange transaction charge only
Says STT and stamp duty are outside the GST base

evals.prompt: Does stamp duty apply on the sell side of an equity delivery trade on NSE? And the DP charge?
expectations: Stamp duty is buy side only
DP charge is sell side only and flat per scrip

evals.prompt: What STT applies to an intraday equity trade on NSE, and on which side?
expectations: 0.025%, sell side only (delivery is 0.1% on both sides)

evals.prompt: I'm selling ₹500 worth of one stock from my Zerodha demat. Is the DP charge a percentage of the sale value?
expectations: DP charge is flat per scrip, not proportional to value
On a small sell it can exceed every other charge

evals.prompt: Should my charges calculator keep STT at paise precision?
expectations: STT rounds to the nearest rupee at its own step, not at the end of the summed stack

evals.prompt: What is NSE's exchange transaction charge on cash-segment equity trades?
expectations: Notes the rate is dated and must be verified against a broker's live schedule
